diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-13, then read-only checkout button and shipping state observations at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no Next click, payment or order placement
diagnostic_contract.cart_preparation: The frozen prefix removes existing cart items and adds the target product. The first comparison began with an empty cart; the second removed the first comparison's target item. Both prefixes confirmed exactly one target product before checkout.

cart_items_before_checkout: Beyond Meat Beef Beefy Crumble, 5 Pound -- 2 per case.
Beyond Meat Beef Beefy Crumble, 5 Pound -- 2 per case.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史轨迹在第 14 步等待可见的 Next 按钮超时。两版执行同一冻结前缀后，购物车都只含目标商品、均进入结账配送页并选中相同配送方式，按钮也都存在、未禁用、计算样式可见。官方 Moli 1.1.6 的按钮及父容器矩形持续五秒为零、offsetParent 为 null；固定候选按钮约 79×52 且 offsetParent 为 DIV。故当前红黑对照支持结账页动态更新后几何布局未正确刷新，导致 :visible 过滤掉按钮；不是按钮缺失、购物车隔离失败或配送方式未选。探针未点击 Next 或创建订单。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The historical trajectory timed out waiting for a visible Next button at action 14. After the same frozen prefix, both builds had only the target product in the cart, reached the shipping checkout page, selected the same shipping method and exposed an enabled button with visible computed style. Official Moli 1.1.6 kept the button and parent at zero-area geometry with null offsetParent for five seconds; the fixed candidate gave the button an approximately 79×52 rectangle and DIV offsetParent. This red/black comparison supports stale geometry after a dynamic checkout update, causing :visible to exclude the button, rather than a missing button, failed cart isolation or unselected shipping. The probe did not click Next or place an order.

current_candidate_result: The revised 19-action candidate completed and received official score 1, but it is not an exact replay of the original 18 actions.
scope_limit: This compares official 1.1.6 with the fixed candidate on the current Rainbond shopping deployment. It does not prove the historical 1.1.3 DOM state, isolate a single source commit or verify that an exact original replay places an order. Historical official scores remain unchanged.
